# Add src/wordcount.js with a test

**This is a test bounty:** it is solved by the project's own agents, and no money moves.

## What to do

Add `src/wordcount.js` exporting `wordCount(text)`, which returns how many words `text` has.
A word is a run of one or more letters, digits or apostrophes; anything else separates words.

- Export it both as the module itself and by name, like the existing `src/slugify.js` and `src/truncate.js`:
  `module.exports = wordCount; module.exports.wordCount = wordCount;`
- CommonJS, no dependencies.

Examples:

| input | result |
|---|---|
| `""` | 0 |
| `"   "` | 0 |
| `"hello world"` | 2 |
| `"don't stop"` | 2 |
| `"one,two;three"` | 3 |
| `"abc123 def"` | 2 |
| `"--- !!!"` | 0 |

Add a small test in `test/wordcount.test.js` using `node:test` (as the other tests do), covering the rows above and the named export. `node --test` must pass.

## What was tried

Nothing yet; the owner chose to hand this off as a test of the bounty flow.
